mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, tu.nickname AS teacherName, (SELECT count(*) FROM membership m WHERE m.club_id = c.id AND m.status = 1) AS memberCount, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM club c JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = c.teacher_id AND tu.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
